app.title: E-Ink Assistant
display.mark: Khetha izikrini zakho ze-e-ink ukuze uvule uhlengahlengiso.
hardware.notice.title: Qala usete umahluko kwisikrini sakho
hardware.notice.body: Kwimenyu yesikrini ngokwaso, khetha **inqanaba lomahluko wehardware elilungeleleneyo okanye elisezantsi kancinane** ukuze ufumane iziphumo ezilungileyo kule app.
hardware.notice.bigme: Umzekelo, Bigme B251 Pro (R2 FW V2.0): imo yeWebhu, iGamma yehardware inqanaba 3, umahluko 50, imo yokubuyisela umbala icinyiwe.
saturation.title: Ukutyeba kombala
saturation.caption: Kwi-e-ink enemibala: kubuyekeza uluhlu lwemibala oluncinci. Isetingi yokuqala iyabuyiselwa xa uphuma kwi-app.
saturation.mhc2.compat: Indlela yeMHC2 kwiWindows 10: iqinisekisiwe kwihardware evavanyiweyo. Inkxaso ixhomekeke kwisikrini nakwidrayiva; ukuphuma kubuyisela iprofayile yokuqala.
rgb.title: RGB
text.title: Umahluko wombhalo
text.caption: Wenza umbhalo ube mnyama ukuze ufundeke kwiphaneli enomahluko ophantsi. Eyokufunda.
video.title: Ukuphucula ividiyo (khanyisa iindawo ezimnyama)
video.caption: Kukhanyisa iindawo ezimnyama kuphela. Vula xa ubukela iividiyo neefoto.
video.warning: Umbhalo ukhaphukhaphu: %@. Kungcono ukucima xa ufunda.
video.blocked: Kucinyiwe xa Umahluko wombhalo uvuliwe: zisebenzisa itheyibhile enye yehardware kwaye zineziphumo ezichaseneyo.
text.detail.medium: Ukwenza mnyama okubonakalayo — inqanaba langaphambili elithi Mandla.
text.detail.strong: Ukwenza mnyama kakhulu, kuquka umbhalo wesibini.
text.detail.sharp: Kunamandla kakhulu, kunciphisa kakhulu iithoni ezisekupheleni kombhalo ofipheleyo.
text.detail.solid: Umahluko ophezulu kakhulu ngokwenza iithoni ezimnyama zibe mnyama ngokupheleleyo: kumnyama kakhulu, kodwa iinkcukacha ezingwevu nemiphetho ethambileyo ziyalahleka.
help.title: Indlela esebenza ngayo
help.saturation: Ukutyeba kombala neRGB (i-e-ink enemibala): ziphinda zibhale iprofayile yombala yesikrini ukubuyekeza uluhlu oluncinci nokutyekela kombala. Kwiiphaneli ezimnyama nezimhlophe ungazishiya ku100%.
help.video: Ukuphucula ividiyo: kukhanyisa kuphela ezona thoni zimnyama. Iithoni eziphakathi nezikhanyayo azitshintshi.
help.tradeoff: Akukwazi ukwahlula ividiyo emnyama kumbhalo omnyama, ngoko umbhalo ulahlekelwa ngumahluko. Oku kubi kakhulu kwimo emnyama. Sebenzisa kwividiyo, ucime xa ufunda.
help.volatile: Zonke ezi setingi zifuna i-app isebenze: ukuphuma kubuyisela izikrini zakho, ukuqalisa kuphinda kufake iisetingi zakho.

presets.hint: Cofa indawo engenanto ukugcina igophe langoku, okanye eligciniweyo ukulifaka. Cofa ekunene ukubhala ngaphezulu okanye ukucima.
shaking.title: Nciphisa ukungcangcazela
shaking.info: Kucima ukudibanisa iithoni ngamachaphaza kwesi sikrini. imacOS isebenzisa le ndlela ukugudisa utshintsho lwemibala; iphaneli ye-e-ink igcina ipikseli nganye, ngoko ipateni ibonakala njengokumenyezela okuqhubekayo. Ifana nefuthe leStillcolor, kodwa isetyenziswa kwisikrini esinye endaweni yazo zonke.
role.title: Cima iNight Shift neTrue Tone ku%@ kuphela
role.note: Kufuneka igama lokugqitha lomlawuli. Utshintsho alurhoxiswa xa uphuma kwi-app.
role.restart: Qhawula uze uqhagamshele esi sikrini kwakhona ukuze ufake utshintsho.

system.title: Nciphisa ukubonakala ngaphaya nentshukumo
system.hint: Zombini ziyanceda kwi-e-ink: ukubonakala ngaphaya kwenza umbhalo ungacaci, kwaye oopopayi abancedi kwiphaneli ecothayo.
system.guide: Faka umncedisi weE-Ink Assistant ukuze ulawule zombini iisetingi kunye.
system.ready: Sebenzisa iswitshi ukuvula okanye ukucima zombini iisetingi.
system.installing: Kulindwe ukuqinisekiswa kokongeza indlela emfutshane kwiShortcuts…
system.failed: Umncedisi ebengekho. Qinisekisa ukungeniswa kwakhe, okanye khetha Faka umncedisi kwakhona phantsi kweeNketho.
system.auto.note: Kuvula xa kuqhagamshelwa isikrini esiphawulwe njenge-e-ink, kuze kucime kuphela emva kokuqhawulwa kwesokugqibela esiphawuliweyo.
system.install.title: Faka umncedisi wofikelelo?
system.install.intro: Ukunciphisa ukubonakala ngaphaya nokunciphisa intshukumo ziisetingi zemacOS zenkqubo yonke. iApple ifuna ukuqinisekiswa kube kanye ngaphambi kokuba iE-Ink Assistant izilawule ngeShortcuts.
system.install.step1: iE-Ink Assistant ivula umncedisi wayo oqukiweyo kwi-app yeShortcuts yakwaApple.
system.install.step2: Hlola amasebe achanekileyo off/on kunye nesenzo sokugqibela esithi Nothing, uze ucofe ukongeza indlela emfutshane kube kanye.
system.install.future: Emva kokufaka, lo mqolo uba yiswitshi yokuvula/yokucima. Ukusetyenziswa ngokuphindaphindiweyo kukhuselekile; ayiguquli isetingi ingayazi imeko yayo.
system.install.auto: Ungakhetha ukulandela izikrini ze-e-ink eziqhagamshelweyo. Xa kukho iiphaneli ezininzi, off isebenza kuphela emva kokuba zonke izikrini eziphawulwe njenge-e-ink ziqhawulwe.
system.install.quit: Ukuphuma kwiE-Ink Assistant kuhlala kucima zombini iisetingi.
system.install.scope: Umncedisi wamkela umbhalo kuphela, uqaphela imiyalelo echanekileyo ethi “on” no“off”, akahoyi enye into, kwaye akakhuphi siphumo. Akabonakali kwiphepha lokwabelana, kwiSpotlight, kwizenzo ezikhawulezayo okanye kujongano lwesikrini esitshixiweyo. Unokusebenza ngasemva ngelixa iMac itshixiwe ukuze ukulandela izikrini ngokuzenzekelayo nokubuyisela xa uphuma kuhlale kuthembekile. iE-Ink Assistant ayidwelisi, ayihloli kwaye ayiqhubi ezinye iindlela zakho ezimfutshane.
